sections.label: School rules on student tattoos
sections.summary: Schools bar visible tattoos in uniform, ask students to cover or remove them, and use counselling, parent engagement and an educative approach.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Generally, schools encounter only a handful of such cases for older students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Students in our schools are not allowed to have tattoos on visible parts of their body while in school uniform.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Students sporting tattoos will either be asked to cover up their tattoos or to have them removed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Tattooing may result from the students' need to express their personal identity, an act of defiance or to fit into certain social circles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Schools, therefore, provide counselling to help students work through possible underlying issues which have led them to sporting a tattoo.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Schools also actively engage their parents to guide students in making healthy and right choices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: In managing students with tattoos, schools adopt an educative approach.

sections.label: Tattooing outside school environment
sections.summary: Tattooing occurs outside school, raising considerations about how it might be taken forward, though it could be explored.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: With respect to the second issue, the process of tattooing happens outside the school environment, so there are some considerations about how that might be taken forward, but it is something we could explore.
